comparison.objective: Press E-STOP, clear a jammed block, then RESET and START; candidate isolates an axis, adjusts its damper, then operates a guarded cycle control to validate stopping behavior.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests safety-control sequencing and jam removal; candidate adds recessed hex-key use, counterholding, fine collar rotation, torque-limited relocking, and iterative physical tuning.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the jam cleared only after E-STOP and the system reset/restarted in order; candidate requires physical unlock/adjust/lock actions and two quantitatively safe cycles, with zero score for energized adjustment.
comparison.reason: There is limited overlap in safety-state sequencing and physical control actuation, but the central tested ability differs: jam recovery versus damper adjustment and dynamic-response commissioning. The PR has no specs or stated jam-force/damage thresholds.
